ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, the upper part is a structure of a benzene ring connected to NH2, namely aniline; below the nitrogen are drawn a lone pair of electrons and a curved arrow pointing to the lower substrate. The lower part is a benzene ring connected to a carbonyl carbon, and the carbonyl carbon is further connected to a bromine-containing methylene fragment, overall Ph-C(=O)-CH2Br; there is also a curved arrow on the right side. According to the problem statement, ignore all curved arrows and write only the two unbonded molecules as SMILES. The upper Ph-NH2 is written as Nc1ccccc1; the lower Ph-C(=O)-CH2Br is written as O=C(CBr)c1ccccc1. The two molecules are not connected, therefore connect them with a period.
